distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) reported Sichuan (Miyaluo, Shuajingsi), Yunnan (Lijiang). Huang & Lu (2015) reported Sichuan, Yunnan. These are literature-based reports; the mainland-China occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending checklist review. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Shaanxi as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Host names are retained as published, with separate source citations for 1984 and 2015; the latter may repeat earlier evidence rather than represent independent host confirmation. Host associations have not yet undergone independent review.
